text:
Priya (CS): FYI - NovaTech renewal scheduled next Tue. They're proposing to move from a 12mo to a 9mo term, add +15 seats, and split billing across EU and US entities. Asking if onboarding credit can be prorated to the shortened term. Any red flags?
Sam (Sales): Key Q: will unit price stay the same for 9mo? They want price parity. Also need PO routing for procurement.
Priya (CS): They insist on separate invoices for each entity due to internal chargebacks. That may delay signing.
Tom (Legal): Separate invoices ok from contract perspective. Need tax IDs, exact legal names, and PO numbers. I'll prepare a short amendment that covers term change and credit allocation.
Maria (Billing): We can do invoice-split but require vendor codes and billing contacts for each entity. EU invoices must include VAT handling. If the onboarding credit is to be split, specify allocation method.
Priya (CS): Customer prefers credit allocated proportionally by invoice amount. Can we support that?
Maria (Billing): Yes, pro rata allocation is supported. Will need written approval in the amendment or SOW.
Sam (Sales): I'll push to keep unit price flat. @Tom please add clause: "Onboarding credit to be applied pro rata across invoices for the 9-month term."
Tom (Legal): On it. Drafting a 2-paragraph amendment and will route via DocuSign.
BillingBot: Invoice preview generated:
```
INVOICE PREVIEW
NovaTech EU (Entity A) - 9,750 - 9mo prorated (10 seats)
NovaTech US (Entity B) - $6,500 - 9mo prorated (5 seats)
Onboarding credit: 1,200 applied pro rata
```
Priya (CS): One more ask from the customer: schedule onboarding enablement within 30 days of signature and provide a go-live checklist. Can Product Operations commit?
Sam (Sales): I'll include two live training sessions + recorded materials, no extra charge.
Tom (Legal): I'll include an onboarding schedule and acceptance criteria in the amendment.
Maria (Billing): After amendment is signed I can issue both invoices and apply the pro rata credit. Need vendor codes + PO numbers by EOD Thursday to meet billing cycle.
Priya (CS): I'll collect vendor codes and PO numbers and confirm onboarding dates with NovaTech today. Updating the renewal board and adding a follow-up reminder. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
